The $$2.5th$$ and $$97.5th$$ percentiles of the bootstrap distribution for the studentized mean
$$ rac{\hat{	heta}**{*}-\hat{	heta}}{SE(\hat{	heta}**{*})}$$
are located at $$-2.2$$ and $$1.9$$, respectively. Which of the following constitutes a valid 95% bootstrap confidence interval for the parameter $$	heta$$
Recall that $$\hat{	heta}=8.4$$ and $$SE(\hat{	heta})= rac{2}{\sqrt{100}}$$
